verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two related capabilities, but neither is a recurring schedule. Brevo can schedule an email for a single future time (a one-off action), and it offers event-triggered multi-step automation workflows. No evidence shows jobs or workflows set to repeat on a cron-like or recurring cadence, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
